title: AQ Podcast | The Mexico-U.S. Relationship: Tensions and a Path Forward
gist: Podcast blurb for AQ's discussion with Vanessa Rubio-Marquez on Mexico-US ties: Mexico sends over 80% of exports to the US and gets $60 billion a year in remittances, tensions are rising over security cooperation, extraditions and USMCA, and she argues for a middle path.

insights.claim: Mexico sends more than 80% of its exports to the US and receives more than $60 billion a year in remittances from citizens living there.
insights.speaker: OCTOBER 15, 2026
insights.so_what: Quantifies the dependence that limits Mexican bargaining options.

insights.claim: Tensions between Mexico and the US are rising again over US demands for greater security cooperation, extradition requests for Morena politicians, and uncertainty over the future of USMCA.
insights.speaker: OCTOBER 15, 2026
insights.so_what: Watch security and extradition headlines as triggers for trade-relationship volatility.
